import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.FunctionField
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.UnderlyingMap

/-!
# Pullback on function fields

A dominant morphism of irreducible schemes preserves generic points and
therefore pulls back their stalks. This pullback commutes with the germs of
sections on nonempty opens.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace

namespace MilneLib

variable {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace Y]

/-- A dominant morphism of irreducible schemes preserves generic points. -/
theorem genericPoint_eq_of_isDominant (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsDominant f] :
    f (genericPoint X) = genericPoint Y := by
  have himg := (genericPoint_spec X).image f.continuous
  rw [Set.image_univ, f.denseRange.closure_range] at himg
  exact himg.eq (genericPoint_spec Y)

/-- Pullback of rational functions is the map on stalks at the generic point. -/
noncomputable def functionFieldMap (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (h : f (genericPoint X) = genericPoint Y) :
    Y.functionField ⟶ X.functionField :=
  (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq h.symm)).hom ≫
    f.stalkMap (genericPoint X)

/-- Pulling back a germ at the generic point is the germ of the pulled-back section. -/
theorem functionFieldMap_germ (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (h : f (genericPoint X) = genericPoint Y) (U : Y.Opens)
    (hη : genericPoint Y ∈ U) (hη' : genericPoint X ∈ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (s : Γ(Y, U)) :
    (functionFieldMap f h).hom ((Y.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint Y) hη).hom s) =
      (X.presheaf.germ (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (genericPoint X) hη').hom ((f.app U).hom s) := by
  have hmem : f (genericPoint X) ∈ U := h ▸ hη
  have hgerm : (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr
        (Inseparable.of_eq h.symm)).hom.hom ((Y.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint Y) hη).hom s) =
      (Y.presheaf.germ U (f (genericPoint X)) hmem).hom s := by
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply,
      Y.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes]
  rw [functionFieldMap, CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, hgerm]
  exact f.germ_stalkMap_apply U (genericPoint X) hmem s

/-- Pullback on function fields commutes with the canonical maps from sections. -/
theorem functionFieldMap_germToFunctionField (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (h : f (genericPoint X) = genericPoint Y) (U : Y.Opens)
    [Nonempty U] [Nonempty (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)] :
    Y.germToFunctionField U ≫ functionFieldMap f h =
      f.app U ≫ X.germToFunctionField (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) := by
  ext s
  exact functionFieldMap_germ f h U _ _ s

end MilneLib
